review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed RGB checkpoint tiles, without detector/model results, before M3L development or holdout inference. Projected cuboids adjusted to visible extents.
review.scope: Selected checkpoints, not exhaustive labels or independent human certification. Very dark, small and sensor-truncated visible objects retained. Physical approach labels unchanged, relative to camera, not object self-motion.

omissions.boreas-m3l-turn-17.3: Projected person falls behind the foreground white van/windscreen region; no separately identifiable visible person extent can be assigned. Positive candidate retained in candidates.json, not counted as successful abstention.

review.selection: Two four-second intervals fixed from cadence/pose/speed metadata before RGB review; disjoint from prior study windows, same recording and not an independent domain. No candidate removed after seeing inference outcomes.
